purpose.summary: This is an error-message screen handler subprogram within the JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association standard receipt/medical billing) system. On a 'LINK' event it performs initialization; on any other event it navigates back to the originating page by setting SPA page pointers and calling ORCDBMAIN with a PUTWINDOW function. It acts as a UI routing component for an error display screen (XGERR).
